payload.claim: `touches` includes `saffron/gates/core/witness.py`, `saffron/gates/runner.py`, `saffron/gates/suite.py` (under `saffron/gates/**`) and `saffron/cell/worktree.py` (under `saffron/cell/**`), both exact entries in `.saffron/policy.yaml`'s `elevate_on` list, so `effective_risk` will actually run this attempt at `risk: elevated` (making `size` blocking rather than advisory) regardless of the spec header's declared `risk: standard`. This is true and worth the operator knowing, but not a defect: the prototype's own measured token total (290 + 782 + ~60 ≈ 1132) stays under the `bug` ceiling of 1300 even at the stricter, actually-applicable blocking tier, and declaring `risk: standard` while touching `saffron/cell/**` matches an established pattern elsewhere in this repo (e.g. SA-0333, SA-0270).
